substrate_class: finite stochastic substrate with local dynamics and after-the-fact sector readouts
allowed_designs: simulate one substrate at two refinements; measure area, amplitude, and route proxies from trajectories; measure an out-of-sample interaction witness after the run
excluded_designs: triple objective in update rule; triple target row as input; pairwise-union witness; post-hoc diagonal forcing; substrate defined to make sectors cohere
independent_witness_requirement: witness must be measured from held-out readout windows, must not enter the update rule, and must test an interaction gain beyond pairwise readouts
success_thresholds: completion Xi <= 0.02 and held-out interaction gain >= 0.05 at both refinements
required_audit: report substrate inputs, readout definitions, Schur residual to common fixed-point subspace, held-out witness, rejected controls, and no-rigging flags.
